DLC2319:3:t_1:3.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「...If you had the chance to learn the future, what would you do?」

DLC2319:3:t_1:4.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「You might discover a rosy future awaits you... or that your life will end tomorrow. Would you still try to learn the future...?」

DLC2319:3:t_1:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「The tale I am about to tell takes place after we learned $$クロノ$$'s doctrine and descended to the surface for the decisive battle with the Empire.」

DLC2319:3:t_1:6.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「The Negotiator, $$ロジャー・スミス$$... $$パラダイムシティ$$... that strange book, $$メトロポリス$$...」

DLC2319:3:t_1:7.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Why did they come into being, and where are they heading...?」

DLC2319:3:t_2:3.en: ~$$マクロス・クォーター$$: Briefing Room~

DLC2319:3:t_2:4.en:
$$万丈$$
「$$クロノ$$ has manipulated human history from the shadows... And my father was involved with them too...」

DLC2319:3:t_2:5.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「To think $$クロノ$$ did not submit to $$サイデリアル$$, but was created by $$サイデリアル$$ in the first place.」

DLC2319:3:t_2:6.en:
$$万丈$$
「Rejecting $$サイデリアル$$... Does that mean bringing on a future of despair?」

DLC2319:3:t_2:7.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「A future of despair... Hmm...」

DLC2319:3:t_2:8.en:
$$万丈$$
「Is something on your mind, $$ロジャー$$?」

DLC2319:3:t_2:9.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「The $$時の牢獄$$ that enclosed $$蒼の地球$$ prevented time from advancing into the future.」

DLC2319:3:t_2:10.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「Perhaps that city, which likewise has neither past nor future, was an escape from that future of despair...」

DLC2319:3:t_2:12.en:
$$万丈$$
「So you're saying the city's creation is also connected to that future of despair?」

DLC2319:3:t_2:13.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「At the very least, the old man living there knew of the $$黒歴史$$... $$ＵＣＷ$$'s worst possible future, in other words.」

DLC2319:3:t_2:14.en:
$$万丈$$
「$$ゴードン・ローズウォーター$$, the former president of the Paradigm Corporation... And his novel, $$メトロポリス$$...」

DLC2319:3:t_2:15.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「I wonder if Lord $$グエン$$ infiltrated $$クロノ$$ because he learned of the future of despair from that book.」

DLC2319:3:t_2:17.en:
$$万丈$$
「When he told us about the $$エグゼクター$$s, he acted as though he knew what lay beyond them, too.」

DLC2319:3:t_2:18.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「Looking back, that was probably what those passages described: the future of despair.」

DLC2319:3:t_2:19.en:
$$万丈$$
「If we want to learn the truth...」

DLC2319:3:t_2:20.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「We have no choice but to visit the old man in person.」

DLC2319:3:t_2:21.en:
$$万丈$$
「Do you have a way to reach $$パラダイムシティ$$?」

DLC2319:3:t_2:22.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「...There is something I would like to try.」

DLC2319:3:t_2:23.en:
$$万丈$$
「Okay, $$ロジャー$$. Then let's hurry.」

DLC2319:3:t_3:7.en:
$$アポロ$$
「What is it...!? What are you trying to tell me!?」

DLC2319:3:t_3:11.en:
$$アポロ$$
「But I get it. Those ancient memories inside me remember your frustration and anger.」

DLC2319:3:t_3:12.en:
$$アポロ$$
「Don't worry! $$アクエリオン$$ and I will settle the score for you!」

DLC2319:3:t_3:13.en:
$$アポロ$$
「We'll beat the hell out of them!」

DLC2319:3:t_3:18.en:
???
「It's been a long time, $$ロジャー$$.」

DLC2319:3:t_3:19.en:
$$エンジェル$$
「I never imagined we would meet again in this city.」

DLC2319:3:t_3:21.en:
$$エンジェル$$
「You don't seem to be in the mood for a happy reunion.」

DLC2319:3:t_3:22.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「...Have you been in $$パラダイムシティ$$ all this time?」

DLC2319:3:t_3:23.en:
$$エンジェル$$
「Not because I wanted to be.」

DLC2319:3:t_3:25.en:
$$エンジェル$$
「I could leave the city... But before I knew it, my feet were carrying me back to this city in the mist.」

DLC2319:3:t_3:26.en:
$$エンジェル$$
「It seems that in exchange for being entrusted with that book's final chapter, I took on the duty of seeing this city's fate through to the end.」

DLC2319:3:t_3:27.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「That book... $$メトロポリス$$...」

DLC2319:3:t_3:28.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「$$ゴードン・ローズウォーター$$ entrusted its final chapter to you?」

DLC2319:3:t_3:29.en:
$$エンジェル$$
「He left it up to me what to do with it, too.」

DLC2319:3:t_3:30.en:
$$エンジェル$$
「Perhaps it means something that we've met again like this... Would you like to hear how the story ends?」

DLC2319:3:t_3:32.en:
$$エンジェル$$
「The choice is entirely yours, $$ロジャー$$.」

DLC2319:3:t_3:35.en:
$$エンジェル$$
「It seems our meeting has incurred someone's wrath...」

DLC2319:3:t_3:36.en:
$$エンジェル$$
「But I knew this would happen someday... Ever since that day, when I touched the truth beneath the city...」

DLC2319:3:t_4:3.en: ~$$マクロス・クォーター$$: Briefing Room~

DLC2319:3:t_4:4.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「...My apologies, $$万丈$$. It seems I dragged you along on a fruitless endeavor after all.」

DLC2319:3:t_4:5.en:
$$万丈$$
「Don't worry about it. It gave me a few things to think about, too.」

DLC2319:3:t_4:6.en:
$$万丈$$
「$$アポロ$$ hasn't said anything either, but something seems to have happened. He looks as though he's put his doubts behind him.」

DLC2319:3:t_4:7.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「I see... Then I am glad.」

DLC2319:3:t_4:8.en:
$$万丈$$
「You seem to have resolved your own doubts as well, $$ロジャー$$.」

DLC2319:3:t_4:9.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「I was able to remember what my job truly is. In that sense, it was time well spent.」

DLC2319:3:t_4:10.en:
$$ロジャー$$
（And now I have the pleasure of looking forward to seeing her again.）

DLC2319:3:t_4:12.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「I know. We must see this future of despair with our own eyes and overcome it.」

DLC2319:3:t_4:13.en:
$$万丈$$
「It certainly sounds like a worthwhile challenge.」

DLC2319:3:t_4:14.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「It will probably require us to stake our lives.」

DLC2319:3:t_4:17.en:
$$万丈$$
「Understood. You have my respect for that professionalism.」

DLC2319:3:t_4:18.en:
$$万丈$$
（I will move forward, too... Having rejected what my father tried to do, I have to prove I can surpass it.）

DLC2319:3:t_4:19.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「$$ラース・バビロン$$ comes first, then.」

DLC2319:3:t_4:20.en:
$$万丈$$
「Yes... Whatever lies beyond it, we'll keep going.」

DLC2319:3:t_4:21.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「Despair does not belong in the future. Let us go and bring hope to it.」

DLC2319:3:t_4:25.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「...And so $$ロジャー$$ renewed his resolve to stand against the world itself.」

DLC2319:3:t_4:26.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Personally, though, I don't mind spoilers, so I would have liked to hear the answer from $$エンジェル$$.」

DLC2319:3:t_4:27.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I'm also curious about what she saw beneath $$パラダイムシティ$$ during the $$多元戦争$$...」

review.context: Roger and Banjo investigate the despairing future through Paradigm City; Apollo encounters Apollonius and Celiane, while Angel offers Roger the final chapter of Metropolis.
decisions: Angel is the Big O character, distinct from the Heralds and other Angel terms.
Apollonius speaker headers explicitly use the pilot token.
Kept interrupted sentences at their original row boundaries.
